title: 樹上横丁｜食器と料理の素材アトラス
titleEn: TreeTop Yokocho | Tableware and Food Surface Atlas
description: 陶器・竹・漆・布・料理など32種の小物表面をまとめたアトラス。クランプ用。シームレスではありません。原画像と縦横比を維持。元のUV配置に合わせて使用するベースカラーです。 128pxセルが8列×4行。セルの切り出しや拡大は行っていません。
descriptionEn: Atlas of 32 small prop surfaces: glazed ceramics, bamboo, lacquer, linen and food. Clamp to edge; not seamless. Original image and aspect ratio preserved. Use the authored UV layout; basecolor only. 8 columns × 4 rows of 128-pixel cells; no individual cell extraction or enlargement.

provenance.notes: No font software distributed. Source-derived preview only. Basecolor is copied byte-for-byte; no external PBR scan or AI texture included.
provenance.verification: Original source PNG SHA256 verified after byte-for-byte copying; generator source reviewed. No claim of exact regeneration for font-dependent historical artwork.
provenance.rights: Xenoah original authored assets. The owner requested publication of their original models and textures in Meshcopia under its CC BY 4.0 rules. External scan images, font software, third-party SDKs and runtime behaviors are not redistributed.
provenance.changes: Original PNG copied byte-for-byte. Separate actual-artwork thumbnail. Mirror surfaces require alternating flipped tiles; clamp artworks retain authored aspect ratio and are not tileable.

previewDescription: Original source image, fitted without cropping; checkerboard behind transparency.
author: Xenoah

usages.context: Original authored texture in the pinned v2.19.0 project; may be a historical source map rather than the current material assignment.
